insight: Yahoo's January 2026 return to search; the answer engine runs on Anthropic's Claude with Microsoft Bing's grounding API.
name: Yahoo Scout
tagline: AI answer engine that synthesizes the web with cited sources.
description: Yahoo's AI-powered answer engine, synthesizing the open web, Yahoo data, and Yahoo content into concise responses with rich media, structured tables, and inline citations. Available as a standalone engine at scout.yahoo.com and inside the Yahoo Search app, with experiences woven across Yahoo Mail, News, Finance, and Sports. Built to drive traffic back to source publishers.

modelSupport.notes: Customized Claude plus Microsoft Bing's grounding API and Yahoo's proprietary data.

edge: Grounds answers in Yahoo's knowledge graph of 1B+ entities and decades of search data, with inline citations that route traffic to publishers.

references.title: Yahoo debuts Scout, an AI search and companion experience
